train_one_epoch: train a stereo or optical flow model for one epoch using a dataloader, criterion, metrics, optimizer, and gradient scaler with mixed precision support
validate_one_epoch: validate a stereo or optical flow model across multiple dataloaders using tiled prediction with confidence-weighted averaging and log results
tiled_pred: run tiled inference on image pairs by splitting them into overlapping crops, computing predictions per tile, and aggregating with confidence-based weighting
split_prediction_conf: split a model prediction tensor into the main prediction and optional confidence channel by separating the last channel when confidence output is enabled
create_overlapping_slices: create overlapping slice offsets for tiling an image dimension into windows with a specified overlap ratio for patch-based inference
